reviews.title: Basically an SM58 at a lower price point.
reviews.comment:
Great bang for the buck - works like an SM58 with no noticeable difference in sound quality.
We A/B compared to an SM58 through a Yamaha board and a proper PA, there was not discernible difference.
So its our opinion that this is a great entry level mic for you smaller gigs at a lower price point.  10/10 would buy again.
reviews.author: David Comeau

reviews.title: Great value
reviews.comment:
